# Direct row-map certificate confirmation program

This directory is generated by scripts/gen_confirmation_protocols.py. It
contains one qualification stage and nine prospective experiments for the
complete direct row-map collapse certificate.

[Q0 instrument qualification](q0_instrument_qualification.md)

- [E0](e0_joint_regularity_cover.md): Disjoint physical row domain and independent cover remainder
- [E1](e1_exact_optimizer_transport.md): Actual program-state successor and operation-ordered transport
- [E2](e2_normal_operator_spectrum.md): Complete Jacobian stack and derivative-defined normal closure
- [E3](e3_structured_path_lyapunov.md): Complete block comparison with every cross coupling
- [E4](e4_complete_defect_decay.md): Primitive source ledger and runtime-to-exact bridge
- [E5](e5_direct_tail_self_map.md): Derived successor-cell self-map
- [E6](e6_finite_entry_horizon.md): Finite, frozen, and controlled-tail collapse conclusions
- [E7](e7_certificate_interventions.md): Paired schedule and certificate interventions
- [E8](e8_heldout_scale_discrimination.md): Held-out scale transfer, observable bridge, and RG closure

All raw observations must validate against record_schema.json and the runtime
checks in experiments/confirm/campaign_record.py. The program uses one global
optimizer clock, physical row units, complete d_k by d_k Jacobians, and
on-disk digest verification. Every record key and estimator owner is
enumerated before launch; completeness is exact set equality.

The immutable registration is [registration.json](registration.json).
